notes:
Quick CRM-style notes and call fragments.
- Company: small sales enablement startup; builds call-summary widget that posts summaries back into HubSpot.
- Primary ask: hosted API (self-serve) for fast time to market + predictable token billing.
- Workload: nightly batch transcript summarization + real-time post-call summary (chat-like prompt pattern).
- Latency/throughput: not ultra-low latency; acceptable: summary delivered within 5-10s after call end. Live streaming preferred for UX but can fall back to batch.
- Cost sensitivity: HIGH. Founder's comment: "we need to keep per-user monthly infra under $2.50" (paraphrase).
- Model preference: reliable summarization; open to mid-sized open models or Redwood-verified variants with fallback to smaller cheap model for low-confidence outputs.
- Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to cheaper model for non-sensitive calls; prefer stronger model when confidence low.
- Security: Legal and Product both flagged PII. Questions: where are audio files stored? Are transcripts persisted by default? How to opt-out or auto-delete? Need examples of retention TTLs and proof of deletion.
- Specific PII ask: ability to redact/obfuscate named entities on ingest, or run a PII-detector step and store only sanitized transcripts. They want both: (a) option to never persist raw audio, (b) transcripts encrypted-at-rest with KMS, (c) audit log of access.
- Retention: legal asks default 30-day retention for transcripts; product prefers 7 days. Need recommended pattern and sample API call to delete transcripts programmatically.
- Compliance: SOC2 is a must; ISO27001 not required yet. Audit logs and KMS integration required.
- Integrations: main path is HubSpot (webhook->our backend->Redwood hosted API->write summary back to HubSpot). Also exploring optional SSO for admin UI.
- Pilot plan: 2-week pilot, ~150 calls/week, avg call 7-12 minutes -> estimate token volume TBD. They want pricing estimate scoped to this pilot before procurement.
- Quote from Founder: "We can't have PII leaks — customer trust is everything for us. If Redwood can show a simple retention + delete flow we'll spin up the pilot immediately."
- Internal notes: prioritize security FAQ + short code sample (node/python) showing: ephemeral audio upload -> call hosted API with redact flag -> delete transcripts after X days. SE Liam to draft and share by 03/15.
- Recommend: show Optimize suggestions (batching/caching) later to lower token costs if pilot successful.
